lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense matrix of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows; the spatial frequency of these local maxima decreases while individual blob diameter increases as the pattern progresses posteriorly from the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement of nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast vertical gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora (Echeneidae) is visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
